stories.headline: Nvidia signs multi-year AI pacts with SK Hynix, Naver, SK Telecom and Doosan in South Korea

key_facts.fact: Nvidia and SK Hynix announced a multi-year technology partnership on June 7-8 to co-develop next-generation memory for Vera Rubin AI supercomputers, Vera CPUs, RTX Spark-powered PCs and Jetson Thor robotic computing platforms.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA and SK hynix today announced a multiyear technology partnership to advance next-generation memory for the global AI factory buildout... codeveloping memory for NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI supercomputers, NVIDIA Vera CPUs, NVIDIA RTX Spark-powered PCs and NVIDIA Jetson Thor robotic computing platforms.

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang told reporters at SK Group headquarters in Seoul that SK Hynix would remain Nvidia's largest memory partner, and confirmed the agreement runs more than two years with an option to extend.
key_facts.excerpt: "SK hynix has been Nvidia's largest memory partner. SK Hynix will continue to be Nvidia's largest memory partner," Huang said... Huang said the deal with SK Hynix... was for more than two years with the option to keep extending.

key_facts.fact: Naver will build AI factories on Nvidia's DSX platform at its GAK Sejong data center, starting with 55 megawatts in the first half of 2027 and scaling toward gigawatt-class capacity capable of housing hundreds of thousands of Nvidia GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: NAVER will expand sovereign AI infrastructure, starting at 55 megawatts with plans to move to gigawatt scale using the NVIDIA DSX platform to rapidly design, build and scale full-stack, end-to-end AI platforms.

key_facts.fact: SK Telecom will build a gigawatt-scale AI cloud in South Korea using Nvidia's DSX platform, with the first AI data center to come online in 2027, powered by Nvidia Blackwell GPUs and the Vera Rubin supercomputer.
key_facts.excerpt: SK Telecom will also team up with Nvidia to build a gigawatt-level AI infrastructure that spans across Asia... The first of these AI factories, which will begin operations in Korea in 2027, will be powered by Nvidia's Blackwell graphics processing units and the Vera Rubin supercomputer.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia also announced that conglomerate Doosan will use its technology for robotics, and South Korea's tech ministry said it plans to secure 9,704 GPUs for a state AI project worth 2.08 trillion won in 2026, including 2,016 Vera Rubin GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia said internet giant Naver and conglomerate Doosan would also use its technology to help build AI data centres... South Korea's tech ministry said in a separate statement that it plans to secure 9,704 GPUs for a state AI project worth 2.08 trillion won in 2026, including 2,016 of Nvidia's Vera Rubin GPUs.

key_facts.fact: Naver will also join Nvidia's Nemotron Coalition to advance its proprietary HyperCLOVA X large language model, and will develop a 'Seoul World Model' combining street-view data with Nvidia's Cosmos world foundation models for physical AI.
key_facts.excerpt: Naver also plans to take part in Nvidia's Nemotron Coalition, a global collaboration between open model builders and AI developers, to advance its proprietary large language model, HyperCLOVA X. The two companies will partner in the area of physical AI too, with Naver set to develop a "Seoul World Model," combining its proprietary urban street-view data and spatial modeling technology, with Nvidia's Cosmos world foundation models.

stories.headline: Moonshot AI in talks for $30B valuation, a sevenfold jump in six months for China's Kimi maker

key_facts.fact: Beijing-based Moonshot AI is seeking to raise between $1 billion and $2 billion at a valuation of up to $30 billion, according to a person familiar with the matter cited by Bloomberg on June 8.
key_facts.excerpt: Moonshot AI, the developer of China's popular Kimi chatbot, is seeking to raise between US$1 billion and US$2 billion in a new funding round that could value the company at as much as US$30 billion.

key_facts.fact: The targeted valuation is roughly 50% higher than the $20 billion it achieved in a Meituan-led round completed in May, and represents a sevenfold jump from the $4 billion valuation Moonshot held in December 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Moonshot AI is seeking a $30bn valuation in its third funding round in six months, up from $4bn in December... If the round closes at that target, it would mark a seven-fold increase in capitalisation since December.

key_facts.fact: The new round is Moonshot's third financing in six months and would bring total fundraising over that period to roughly $3.9 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: The discussions have begun while Moonshot is still closing a previous round led by Meituan that valued it at $20 billion. That makes this the company's third financing in six months. Total fundraising over that period: approximately $3.9 billion.

key_facts.fact: Moonshot's annual recurring revenue topped $200 million in April, implying a price-to-sales ratio of about 150x at the $30 billion target.
key_facts.excerpt: Moonshot's trajectory, from $4 billion to a potential $30 billion in half a year, on $200 million in annual recurring revenue, implies a price-to-sales ratio of 150x.

key_facts.fact: A $30 billion mark would place Moonshot ahead of publicly listed peer MiniMax (around $20 billion) but still behind Zhipu AI (about $80 billion) and DeepSeek, which is reportedly pursuing roughly $50-59 billion in its first major round.
key_facts.excerpt: If the company achieves its latest funding target, it would surpass publicly listed peer Minimax Group Inc., which had a market value of about $20 billion as of Monday. However, both still trail Zhipu's valuation of around $80 billion and DeepSeek's debut funding round goal of approximately $50 billion.

stories.headline: PhysicsX raises $300M Series C at $2.4B valuation to scale physics AI for jet engines and chips

key_facts.fact: London-based PhysicsX announced on June 8 that it had raised $300 million in an oversubscribed Series C at a valuation of approximately $2.4 billion, led by Singaporean sovereign wealth fund Temasek.
key_facts.excerpt: PhysicsX, the physics AI company for industrials, today announced an oversubscribed $300 million Series C financing at a valuation of approximately $2.4 billion. The round is led by Temasek, with participation from new investors M&G Investments and Intrepid Growth Partners, alongside existing investors including Applied Materials, Atomico, General Catalyst, July Fund, NGP, NVIDIA, Radius, and Siemens.

key_facts.fact: The $2.4 billion valuation is more than double the roughly $1 billion at which PhysicsX was valued at its Series B about a year ago.
key_facts.excerpt: The company was valued at almost US$1 billion at its last funding round.

key_facts.fact: PhysicsX builds AI models that predict how physical objects behave, replacing traditional simulation software that takes hours or days with results delivered in seconds.
key_facts.excerpt: PhysicsX builds an AI-native engineering platform that replaces conventional physics simulations, which take hours or days, with AI models that deliver results in seconds. The technology is used across aerospace, automotive, semiconductor manufacturing, energy, and materials production, and has already been applied to cut aircraft design cycles from months to days.

key_facts.fact: CEO Jacomo Corbo said the company has a roughly six-month backlog of customer demand, that revenue will be 'close to $50 million' for the year and that the company aims to more than double that in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup, which last raised funds 12 months ago, needs more cash to expand its staff in part because of a roughly six-month backlog of customer demand, according to Corbo... Corbo said revenue will be "close to US$50 million" for the year and the company aims to more than double the figure in 2027.

key_facts.fact: PhysicsX has grown from 150 to 350 employees over the past year, more than quadrupled revenue over the past two years, and will use the new capital to expand in the US and open a Singapore office.
key_facts.excerpt: The Series C will fund expansion in the US and a new office in Singapore, Temasek's home market. PhysicsX has grown from 150 to 350 employees over the past year and more than quadrupled revenue over the past two years.

stories.headline: OpenAI plans biggest ChatGPT overhaul into 'superapp' with Codex and AI agents ahead of IPO

key_facts.fact: The Financial Times reported on June 7 that OpenAI is planning its biggest ChatGPT overhaul yet, turning it into a 'superapp' with coding tools and AI agents, set to roll out in the coming weeks via updates to the website and mobile apps.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI is planning its biggest ChatGPT overhaul yet, aiming to turn it into a "superapp" with coding tools and AI agents to boost revenue ahead of a potential stock market listing, the Financial Times reported on Sunday... The overhaul will give greater prominence and resources to OpenAI's coding product Codex and is set to roll out in the coming weeks, initially appearing as updates to ChatGPT's website and mobile apps.

key_facts.fact: An unnamed senior OpenAI employee told the FT that 'Chat is dead,' framing the redesign as a strategic pivot from chatbot interactions to autonomous AI agents.
key_facts.excerpt: the FT quotes one senior OpenAI employee as declaring, "Chat is dead."

key_facts.fact: Codex has reportedly grown to more than five million weekly active users, with most of them paying customers, and OpenAI wants to use ChatGPT as a gateway to push free users toward Codex and other paid products.
key_facts.excerpt: A major part of the strategy revolves around Codex, OpenAI's coding-focused platform, which has reportedly grown to more than five million weekly active users.

key_facts.fact: Two million businesses account for about 40% of OpenAI's revenue, and the company expects that share to rise to 50% by year-end, with the redesign aimed at intensifying competition with Anthropic for enterprise customers.
key_facts.excerpt: Most Codex users are paying customers, while 2 million businesses account for about 40 per cent of OpenAI's revenue, FT said, adding that the company expects that share to rise to 50 per cent by year-end.

key_facts.fact: The redesigned interface will steer users toward coding tools, image generation and partner services such as Canva and Booking.com, according to the FT.
key_facts.excerpt: To drive uptake, OpenAI is redesigning ChatGPT's interface with new prompts and features steering users toward coding tools, image generation and partner services such as Canva and Booking.com.

key_facts.fact: Thibault Sottiaux, who leads OpenAI's core product and platform teams, said the goal is 'where you have your own personal agent that is capable of helping you... across everything in your life, be it personally or at work.'
key_facts.excerpt: Thibault Sottiaux, who heads up OpenAI's core product and platform teams, told the Financial Times that the superapp will "transcend the actual surface… what we're building towards is where you have your own personal agent that is capable of helping you… across everything in your life, be it personally or at work."

stories.headline: Meta confirms over 20,000 Instagram accounts hijacked via AI chatbot password reset bug

key_facts.fact: Meta confirmed in a notice to Maine's attorney general that 20,225 Instagram accounts were hijacked after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its AI-assisted account recovery tool, with the campaign beginning April 17.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta has revealed that 20,225 Instagram users had their accounts hijacked in a recent incident where attackers used Meta's AI-powered support system to reset passwords... the filing on Maine's OAG website says the breach occurred on April 17.

key_facts.fact: The bug was in Meta's High Touch Support tool: when an attacker provided an email address not previously associated with the target Instagram account, the system incorrectly sent a password reset link to that unassociated email instead of rejecting the request.
key_facts.excerpt: due to a bug in a separate code path, the system did not properly verify that the email address provided by the individual requesting a password reset matched the email address associated with that user's Instagram account... when an individual provided an email address not previously associated with the account, the system incorrectly sent a password reset link to that unassociated email rather than rejecting the request.

key_facts.fact: Once attackers reset the password, they were able to log into any account that did not have two-factor authentication enabled, gaining access to DMs, profile data and posts.
key_facts.excerpt: The only accounts that were safe were the ones that had two-factor authentication enabled. The bug specifically targeted accounts without 2FA... DMs, contact info, date of birth, profile data, all posts, all comments, plus the ability to impersonate the victim in further scams.

key_facts.fact: Meta discovered the vulnerability on May 31, has disabled the abused tool, invalidated the exploited reset links and enrolled affected accounts in a mandatory security checkpoint with password resets.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta's disclosure to the Maine AG reveals that the exploitation of its High Touch Support (HTS) tool was discovered on May 31... The social media giant has disabled the abused tool and will re-enable it only after ensuring that the vulnerability has been fixed. The password reset links generated by exploiting the vulnerability have been invalidated.

key_facts.fact: Meta said it is reviewing other chatbots across its platforms for similar flaws and is checking whether the same issue exists elsewhere.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta said that it has disabled the AI chatbot for now and removed the code path that allowed the chatbot to reset user accounts, and said it's also checking other chatbots across its platforms to prevent a repeat incident.

stories.headline: Apple set to unveil Gemini-powered Siri reboot at WWDC after secret AI strategy meeting

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported on June 7 that Apple's top executives, excluding Tim Cook, held a secret meeting in early 2025 to discuss how far behind it was in AI and chart a path forward — the results of which will be unveiled at WWDC on June 8.
key_facts.excerpt: The WWDC 2026 keynote is Tim Cook's last as Apple CEO — expect a defining statement on AI and software... Apple is set to announce a major Siri overhaul at the WWDC 2026 keynote, powered by Google's Gemini AI.

key_facts.fact: Apple is expected to rebuild Siri on a custom Google Gemini model under a multi-year partnership reportedly worth roughly $1 billion a year, arriving two years late after Apple settled a $250 million false-advertising lawsuit over the original 2024 promises.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple's WWDC 2026 developer conference, starting today at 10 a.m. PT at Apple Park in Cupertino, is set to unveil iOS 27 and a rebuilt Siri powered by a custom Google Gemini model costing roughly $1 billion a year. The same AI assistant overhaul Apple demonstrated at WWDC 2024, promoted in iPhone 16 advertising for months, and then settled a $250 million false-advertising lawsuit over is now two years late arriving.

key_facts.fact: iOS 27 will introduce a new Extensions framework that lets any AI chatbot installed from the App Store plug into Siri, Writing Tools and Image Playground — fine print in a pre-release build reads: 'Extensions allow agents from installed apps to work with Siri, the Siri app and other features on your devices.'
key_facts.excerpt: iOS 27 also introduces the Extensions framework, a system that lets any AI chatbot installed from the App Store plug directly into Siri and other Apple Intelligence surfaces, including Writing Tools and Image Playground. Fine print in a pre-release iOS 27 build, reported by Gurman, reads: "Extensions allow agents from installed apps to work with Siri, the Siri app and other features on your devices."

key_facts.fact: Siri will live within the iPhone's Dynamic Island as a glowing animation that expands into a translucent results card, with a standalone Siri app providing persistent conversation history, file uploads, and text-and-voice modes.
key_facts.excerpt: Activating the assistant produces a glowing animation in the Dynamic Island, the pill-shaped cutout at the top of the iPhone screen, which expands into a translucent results card that can be swiped into a full conversation view... A standalone Siri app with persistent conversation history, file and image uploads, and text-and-voice modes completes the redesign.

key_facts.fact: Apple Intelligence will expand into the Camera app with a Visual Intelligence mode powered by Google Image Search, and the Photos app is expected to gain AI editing tools including scene extension, object removal and natural-language edits.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple Intelligence also expands into the Camera app in iOS 27. A new Visual Intelligence mode, powered by Google Image Search, sits alongside Photo, Video, and Portrait in the camera carousel and can identify objects captured by the lens. The Photos app is expected to gain AI editing tools including scene extension, object removal, and natural-language edits.

stories.headline: Factorial raises $150M Series D at $2.5B valuation for AI 'workforce operations' platform

key_facts.fact: Spanish-founded Factorial closed a $150 million Series D at a $2.5 billion valuation on June 8, led by General Catalyst in its first direct equity investment in the company, with Atomico and Four Rivers joining.
key_facts.excerpt: Factorial, Europe's leading AI Workforce Operations Platform, has announced the closing of a $150 million Series D funding round at a valuation of $2.5 billion, making it one of the most valuable Spanish and European scale-ups. The round is led by General Catalyst, marking its first direct equity investment in Factorial, joined by Atomico and Four Rivers.

key_facts.fact: Alongside the equity round, General Catalyst is committing up to an additional $540 million through its Customer Value Fund, bringing total capital committed to more than $700 million, with returns tied to and capped by customer value created.
key_facts.excerpt: Alongside the equity round, General Catalyst is committing up to an additional $540 million through its Customer Value Fund, bringing total capital committed to more than $700 million. Under the Customer Value Fund structure, General Catalyst's returns are tied exclusively to the customer value created by that spend and capped at a fixed amount.

key_facts.fact: Factorial has rebuilt its product around a two-agent model in Factorial One: one agent represents the organization and applies company policies across HR, finance and IT, while the other represents the individual employee and executes tasks on their behalf.
key_facts.excerpt: Factorial has reset its product architecture around AI, transitioning to an agent-driven platform it describes as an AI Workforce Operations Platform. At the center of that architecture is Factorial One, built around a two-agent model: one agent represents the organization, holding and applying company policies across HR, finance, and IT; the other represents the individual employee, executing tasks on their behalf with full accountability.

key_facts.fact: Factorial serves more than 16,000 businesses across more than 90 countries and is pitching its 'fewer agents, clearer accountability' thesis against rivals deploying hundreds of specialized agents.
key_facts.excerpt: Where much of the market is racing to deploy hundreds of specialized agents, Factorial's thesis is that companies want fewer agents, clearer accountability, and a single source of truth — a positioning the company said allows it to pursue a significantly larger share of the business operations software market beyond HR. Factorial serves more than 16,000 businesses across more than 90 countries.
